name: New Yorker Gouache Editorial
summary: Intellectual magazine editorial illustration inspired by The New Yorker and Monocle: 300gsm warm cotton rag paper (#F5EFE4), velvety matte opaque gouache plates (French Ultramarine #1D3C6B, Burnt Terracotta #D14832, Mustard Ochre #E2A93B, Sage Olive #587764) with dry-brush bristle feathering and 3–4px print offset, loose vine-charcoal linework with graphite compass construction arcs, Sempé/Steinberg visual metaphors, drop-cap serif essay columns, and single-line italic cartoon captions. Natively supports both 1920×1080 (16:9 spread) and 1080×1440 (3:4 vertical column).
